channel.title: FullBars: Guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides and news on broadband, mobile, landlines and switching in the UK, USA and Europe, checked against Ofcom, FCC and EU sources.

item.title: The digital landline switchover: what you need to know
item.description: The UK’s copper phone network closes by 31 January 2027. What digital voice means for your landline, telecare alarms and power cuts, and how to stay safe.

item.title: Mid-contract price rises: the pounds-and-pence rule
item.description: Since January 2025, UK phone and broadband providers must show mid-contract price rises in pounds and pence. What the Ofcom rule means and when you can leave.

item.title: One Touch Switch: how switching broadband works now
item.description: One Touch Switch lets your new UK broadband provider handle the whole switch, even between networks like Openreach, Virgin Media and altnets. How it works.

item.title: How to read an FCC broadband label
item.description: US internet providers must show an FCC “broadband facts” label. How to read the price, fees, speed and latency details and use them to compare plans fairly.

item.title: eSIM explained
item.description: What an eSIM is, which phones support it, how to switch networks or add a travel eSIM, and the pros and cons compared with a physical SIM card.
